description: This file defines the object IndiceActivityMenuBridge which provides menu handling for starting a playback activity directly. It includes methods to inflate a menu and handle menu item selections, specifically to initiate PlaybackActivity with a preset content ID.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu resource into the provided Menu object for the activity.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selection; if the specific start playback action is selected, it launches PlaybackActivity with a predefined content ID.
